Advances: specled.tagged_tests, specled.verification

Three cheap optional items from the specled_-viv pre-ship consolidated review (~/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/specled_ex/2026-07-24/specled_-viv-seed-echo-coverage/20260724-143147-consolidated.md, review_commit 601f829, Tier 1 empty, all findings Low):

1. Add 'assert seeded' / 'assert seedless' nil-guards after the Enum.find calls in verifier_test.exs 'a generic command failure echoes the seed...' (testing L1; also flagged by the elixir-test-critic during implement) — robustness of the failure message only.
2. Spec prose precision: findings_echo_exunit_seed says the resume suffix names the resume seed 'next to the resume run's hang suspects' but adjacency is not asserted; either weaken prose to 'shall also name' or assert ordering (spec L1).
3. The stderr capture-failure warning is asserted for presence, not that it 'names the failure'; assert a substring of the actual Exception.message (spec L2).

Cross-cutting theme worth honoring: assertions are over-coupled to cosmetic prose yet under-assert dynamic clauses — prefer contract tokens.

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: small
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
All three items remain. Precise end state:

1. test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs — insert between :1896 and :1898:
     assert seeded
     assert seedless
   (immediately after the two Enum.find bindings, before the `assert seeded["message"] =~ ...` block).

2. .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md:300-303, requirement id `specled.tagged_tests.findings_echo_exunit_seed`. Pick ONE:
   (a) CHEAP (recommended): weaken the prose — replace "the resume-timeout suffix shall additionally name that resume seed next to the resume run's hang suspects" with "...shall also name that resume seed in the resume-timeout suffix, alongside the resume run's hang suspects" → i.e. drop the positional word "next to" so the requirement claims co-presence, which is what the test proves. Keep the trailing "so each seed is paired with the run it reproduces" rationale.
   (b) EXPENSIVE: keep the prose and assert ordering in test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs:1816-1861 (the "a shared-fate timeout finding..." / resume-double-timeout test at ~:1816) by capturing the resume-suffix segment and asserting the resume seed string and the resume hang-suspect test id occur in the same suffix segment (e.g. `[_, suffix] = String.split(beta["message"], "resume pass", parts: 2)` then `assert suffix =~ "222222"` and `assert suffix =~ "BetaTest.hang"`, plus an index comparison proving the seed precedes/follows the suspect list as worded).
   If (a) is chosen, no code change is needed; if (b), no spec change is needed.

3. test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs — strengthen BOTH capture-failure warning assertions so the dynamic half of verifier.ex:2451 is load-bearing:
   - at :2261-2262 and at :2324-2325, add an assertion on a substring of the real `Exception.message(e)` produced by `File.mkdir_p!` against a path under a regular file — e.g. `assert stderr =~ "not a directory"` and/or `assert stderr =~ Path.join(blocker, "nested")` (the blocker path is in scope in both tests: :2236/:2237 and :2296/:2298).
   - Verify by falsification before committing: replace `#{Exception.message(e)}` with `""` at lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2451 and confirm both tests go RED, then revert.

Run after: mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix test test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, mix spec.check --no-run-commands.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASHES: no risk. The work touches only a test file and (option 2a) a requirement `statement:` string. .spec/realization_hashes.json holds api_boundary hashes for named implementation bindings; `verification.spec.md` realized_by lists SpecLedEx.Verifier.verify/3 etc. (verification.spec.md:24-32) and `tagged_tests_verification.spec.md` lists SpecLedEx.TaggedTests.* (tagged_tests_verification.spec.md:32-37). `preserve_failed_output/4` is a private defp and is bound to nothing. No lib/ edit is required, so no hash recompute and no realization-drift exposure.

BRANCH GUARD: editing test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs puts two subjects in the file-touch impacted set — it is on the surface of `.spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md:28` AND `.spec/specs/decision_governance.spec.md:19`. This exposure is ALREADY OPEN on this branch: git diff --stat main..HEAD shows verifier_test.exs (+293) changed with tagged_tests_verification.spec.md (+59) and verification.spec.md (+34) updated but decision_governance.spec.md untouched, and the branch shipped green at 0.10.0 — so decision_governance already yields via realization attestation / file-touch-yields-to-realization. This ticket adds no NEW guard exposure. Item 2a additionally updates tagged_tests_verification.spec.md, which keeps that leg satisfied either way.

SPEC-REQUIREMENT OVERLAP: `specled.tagged_tests.findings_echo_exunit_seed` and `specled.verify.command_findings_echo_exunit_seed` are touched by no other ticket in the set (checked all 21 sibling bodies).

ADJACENT-BUT-NOT-COLLIDING: specled_-chb edits comments in lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex at :2404-2405 — the same forensic-capture function (`preserve_failed_output/4`) this ticket's item 3 exercises, but a different FILE than anything zek edits, so no textual conflict. Ordering note for the orchestrator: chb's own body records that ANY lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex edit re-opens `branch_guard_missing_subject_update` against specled.prose_guard (prose_guard.spec.md:19) with no attestation downgrade available. If chb lands and turns the guard red, zek's gate run will inherit that failure even though zek did not cause it — run zek's gate before chb, or expect the prose_guard finding to be chb's to resolve. specled_-ehv also advances specled.verification but targets `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach` and test-setup temp names, not the seed-echo or capture requirements.

NO DEPENDENCY on another ticket landing first. Ticket status is open/not-started (bw shows "○"), and all three items are independent of each other — they can be applied in any order or split.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items 1-3), which is what you implement.

## Allowed touches
- `test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs`
- `.spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md` — only if you pick option (a)
  for item 2. Spec co-change is AUTHORIZED and takes precedence over Out of Scope
  when the gate demands it.

Pick ONE arm of item 2: (a) reword the requirement so it claims co-presence
rather than position, OR (b) keep the prose and assert ordering in the test.
If (a), no new test assertion is needed for item 2; if (b), no spec change is.
State which arm you chose and why in your completion record.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex` — you will TEMPORARILY mutate line ~2451 to prove
  item 3 red, then REVERT it. The committed diff must not contain any
  `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex` change. specled_-chb owns that file; any edit
  there also re-opens `branch_guard_missing_subject_update` against
  `specled.prose_guard` with no attestation downgrade available.
- `.spec/specs/verification.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/decision_governance.spec.md`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- No new dependencies; no refactor of the verifier test file beyond the three
  named items.
- `.spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md` is APPEND-ONLY-checked for
  deletions and downgrades. Option 2a rewords one statement in place — make it a
  precision change, not a weakening. `append_only/requirement_deleted` and
  `append_only/must_downgraded` are `:error`.

## FALSIFIABILITY BAR — this ticket is one of the five the epic gates on
"Tests pass" is NOT evidence for item 3. You must:
1. Replace `#{Exception.message(e)}` with `""` at `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex`
   (~:2451).
2. Run the two capture-failure tests and CONFIRM BOTH GO RED. Paste the failure
   output into your completion record.
3. Revert the mutation. Confirm both go green again.
4. Record the mutation, the red output, and the revert in the COMMIT MESSAGE.

An implementation that skips this is bounced on sight, regardless of whether the
suite is green.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs`
3. `mix format --check-formatted`
4. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
5. `git diff --name-only` must NOT list `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex`.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.

IMPLEMENTED
Session: k6s-zek-impl-1
Log: /Users/mz/.local/state/agentic-runs/specled_ex/specled_-zek/grok-k6s-zek-impl-1/log

Commit: 4a30e2ee7a218a48956704a079b1d588670ac649
Files touched: test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md
Tests added: (no new tests) strengthened SpecLedEx.VerifierTest "a generic command failure echoes the seed and a seedless failure appends no note" (assert seeded/seedless nil-guards); strengthened "a merged run whose capture dir is unwritable keeps its findings and warns once" and "passing commands write no capture and an unwritable dir leaves the result unchanged" (assert Exception.message dynamic half: "not a directory" + nested blocker path)
Verification stubs flipped: none (no execute:false stubs in scope)
Verification tier: change-scoped — mix compile --warnings-as-errors; mix test test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs; mix format --check-formatted; mix spec.check --no-run-commands; full-system proof deferred to the merge gate / PR CI
Final-tier runs: 2
Item 2 arm: (a) — reworded findings_echo_exunit_seed to claim co-presence (alongside) rather than positional adjacency (next to); cheaper and matches existing double-timeout coverage. No ordering assertion added.
Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info (commit trailer). verifier_test.exs also surfaces on specled.verification and specled.decisions; tagged_tests co-changed for item 2a; remaining cross-surface subjects had no requirement change — trailer preferred over out-of-scope co-edits per orchestrator guidance. Gate green after trailer.

Falsifiability (item 3): mutated lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2451 Exception.message(e) → ""; both capture-failure tests RED:
  1) ...unwritable keeps its findings and warns once — assert stderr =~ "not a directory" left: "specled: forensic output capture failed (); verification result unaffected\n"
  2) ...unwritable dir leaves the result unchanged — same assertion failure
Reverted via git checkout -- lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex; both green. Commit name-only: only the two Allowed touches files.

Summary: Applied all three viv Tier-2 precision items. Nil-guards make Enum.find seed/seedless bindings fail closed; requirement prose now claims co-presence of resume seed and hang suspects without over-claiming order; capture-failure stderr assertions load-bear Exception.message via "not a directory" and the nested path. No lib/ or realization_hashes.json changes.
